basic_info.description: First time on the market in decades! This well-maintained Edwardian home offers timeless charm and a prime location near Clement Street, California Street, and Geary Boulevard shops and restaurants. Enjoy close proximity to public transit, The Presidio, Baker Beach, China Beach, Ocean Beach, Lands End trails, Lincoln Park Golf Course, the Legion of Honor, and Golden Gate Park. The upper level features three spacious bedrooms, a sunroom that can serve as a fourth bedroom or office, and a split full bath. The main floor boasts a bright east-facing living room with fireplace, formal dining room, an eat-in kitchen, family room, and a convenient powder room. There is direct access to the rear yard from this level. Perfect for indoor-outdoor living. The ground level includes two-car tandem parking, a large laundry room, and abundant space for storage or potential expansion. Freshly painted inside and out, with newly refinished original hardwood floors and brand new hardwood flooring in the kitchen and family room. Expansive, level backyard beautifully trimmed back with lush greenery and mature privacy trees - your own private oasis for relaxing or entertaining. A rare opportunity in a highly sought-after neighborhood!
